children: New contracts are one-tenth the size of CME Micro E-mini futures, giving eligible Webull customers greater flexibility to manage market exposure
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Webull (

), an online investment platform, today announced that eligible customers will have access to CME Group's E-nano S&P 500 and E-nano Nasdaq-100 futures, expanding the platform's futures offering with smaller-sized contracts. This expands Webull's futures offering with smaller contracts that allow retail investors to manage exposure to major U.S. equity indexes in more precise increments.

CME Nano Futures are ultra-small equity index futures contracts sized at one-tenth of comparable CME Micro E-mini futures. The smaller contract size allows investors to take positions with less notional exposure and potentially lower dollar margin requirements, providing greater control over position sizing and the ability to manage risk in smaller increments.
"Our vision is to ensure Webull continues to evolve alongside the needs of individual investors and the many ways they engage with the markets," said
Anthony Denier, Group President and U.S. CEO of Webull
. "The addition of CME Nano Futures reflects that vision by expanding the breadth of products available through the platform and strengthening our futures offering."
"As our retail futures customer base continues to grow, CME Nano Futures expand the Webull experience by giving customers a more accessible way to participate in major equity index markets," said
Tanmay Sheth, FCM Product Head- Futures and Prediction Markets at Webull
. "This launch reflects our commitment to enhancing the retail experience for futures and derivatives products through flexible, customer-focused trading tools."

Through Webull, eligible customers can trade Nano Futures alongside the platform's existing futures products and use the same tools and functionality to monitor markets, manage positions and make informed trading decisions. The contracts are available to customers with an approved Webull futures account and remain subject to applicable account, margin, risk and jurisdictional requirements.

The addition of Nano Futures builds on Webull's expansion of its futures offering and gives eligible retail customers another way to manage equity index exposure. By enabling positions in smaller increments, the contracts can support more precise position sizing across a broader range of account sizes, expanding the ways investors can manage market exposure and tailor their strategies to their individual risk preferences.
CME Nano Futures are expected to be available to eligible Webull customers in mid-September.
To learn more about futures trading on Webull, please visit: www.webull.com/trading-investing/futures
